sections.en: Total market capitalization stands near $10.3B (CoinGecko). Reported 24-hour spot volume is $1.18B with 7-day average turnover elevated versus the trailing month (1.17x) . Note: the sentiment reading above is the public alternative.me series; proprietary on-chain datasets are still left out rather than estimated. The alternative.me Fear & Greed gauge prints 70 (Greed).

**Derivatives positioning.** The public Binance futures endpoints did not answer for this asset on this cycle, so rather than fabricate a view the desk flags it as a **data gap**: funding and open-interest extremes remain the standard trigger for squeeze dynamics in Cardano.

**Trend structure.** Across horizons the picture is mixed — the moving averages are interleaved rather than stacked, which is characteristic of a transitional or range-bound regime rather than a one-way trend. Spot at $0.2743 versus EMA20 $0.2430, EMA50 $0.2245 and EMA200 $0.2416 frames the medium-term bias mechanically rather than emotionally. From this configuration the desk's working assumption is that trend-following exposure is only justified while price holds the side of the 50-day average it currently occupies.

**Key levels.** The operational map reads: initial support at $0.2592 (recent swing low); the lower Bollinger band $0.2056 as the 2σ downside envelope; upper band $0.2783 as the stretch target. Levels derived from the last ~60 sessions of closes are guides for location, not promises of reaction; they mark where prior two-way business was done and therefore where resting liquidity is most plausible. ATR(14) of $0.0146 implies a typical daily range of roughly 5.3 percent of spot, which is the unit of risk to size positions against.

**Momentum.** RSI(14) prints 70.7 — overbought territory; MACD (12/26/9) sits above its signal line (0.01182 vs 0.01083, histogram +0.0009962), consistent with building momentum. Momentum readings are state descriptors, not trade signals on their own; the desk treats confluence between momentum and level location as the actionable unit.

**Volatility & liquidity.** 30-day realized volatility annualizes near 71%; the 20-day band spans 30% of the mid — expanded, which favors trend continuation tactics; 7-day turnover runs at 1.17x the trailing-month norm. Behavior around these regimes — absorption at band edges, volume confirmation on breaks — is what separates a tradeable move from noise.

**Performance context.** On longer windows the asset has returned +25.51% over 30 days and +57.18% over 90 days. Positioning decisions made on monthly horizons should respect these base rates instead of extrapolating the last week. The 7-session change (+10.98%) is the shortest window the desk treats as signal rather than noise.

sections.en:
**Bullish scenario.** Continuation higher requires continued holds of the 50-day average ($0.2245); RSI holding above 60 (currently 71). Under those conditions the path of least resistance flips to buy-the-dip, with prior resistance converting to support as the confirmation test.

**Bearish scenario.** Downside continuation triggers on a decisive loss of $0.2592. In that case failed support typically becomes the new ceiling, and momentum chasers provide the exit liquidity.

Net take on Cardano: spot $0.2743 with the medium-term bias constructive while price holds the relevant side of the 50-day average. The 24-hour tape (+11.45%) is consistent with that bias. Decision zones are the levels named in the technical section, not opinions: trade the reaction at those prices, not the headline of the day.
